name: Lionheart Fixt
author: vkays
description: A cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt. Releases 0.1.0 'The Horde', 0.1.1 'The Crossroads Patrol', 0.1.2 'Standing', 0.1.4 'What Playtesting Found' and 0.2.0 'What Was Written'. The goblins of the Wilderness are the most developed evil content in the game and in vanilla they feed nothing; Fixt makes the Horde a real faction with three accumulating ranks on the shipped Saladin/Templar pattern, puts back two finished characters that shipped with zero map references, and restores dialogue the original writers finished and the scripters never wired -- the Goblin Girl's cut follow behaviour, the Khan's war campaign against Barcelona, and Grumdjum's post-dryad conversation. Every check adds a route and none removes one, so the vanilla solution to every scene still works.
